high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the film "Shell," directed by Max Minghella. The poster has a dark, moody atmosphere with a predominantly black background, which creates a sense of mystery and intrigue. Title and Credits: The title "SHELL" is prominently displayed in large, metallic silver letters at the top center of the poster. Below the title, it states "A MAX MINGHELLO FILM," indicating the director's name. The names of the actors are listed at the top: Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, and Kaia Ger
